race.description: Kawana Surf Club Of The Year Qld Hcp (Bm65)
race.comment: YES DONALD YES (6) has returned in good order, having won at the Gold Coast before being beaten only half a length as favourite, with a held-up run adding merit to that latest effort. CRACKENTHORPE (8) was second at this track last start, has proven track-and-distance form and looks ready to produce a stronger third-up showing. BOLD ARTIC (5) was well below his best last time when tackling stiffer company but has sincee been freshened and loves racing on the home track. Back to 1400m also suits. After some key scratchings he can play a major role. RHETORIC (11) doesn't lack fitness and can make his presence felt late if the pace is genuine.
